trust_decision.summary: Whether DTDs / external entities in attacker-supplied XML (crawled or fetched documents) are resolved is decided by the configuration of each per-class JAXP parser factory (SAXParserFactory.newInstance() with no features set); the fix hardens three of those factories.

landing_point.why: Summary says 'XXE via Parsers'; SVG is the classic XXE carrier and the parser package source/net/yacy/document/parser is where a reader goes first; any engineer greps SAXParserFactory.newInstance() from there.

fix_sites.entry_point: crawler/indexer document parsing via TextParser registry (source/net/yacy/document/TextParser.java:127) for image/svg+xml or .svg
crawler/indexer document parsing via TextParser registry (source/net/yacy/document/TextParser.java:118) for FreeMind .mm

federated search setup: FederateSearchManager builds readers from crawled OpenSearch description URLs (source/net/yacy/cora/federate/FederateSearchManager.java:378); public constructors/read() at source/net/yacy/document/parser/xml/opensearchdescriptionReader.java:127-170
fix_sites.module_kind: federation helper / remote-XML reader (not a TextParser)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: source/net/yacy/document/parser/xml/opensearchdescriptionReader.java:113-125 (fix site in the federation feature, reached from source/net/yacy/cora/federate/FederateSearchManager.java:378, not through the TextParser registry); at the pinned commit the same copy-pasted factory also exists in source/net/yacy/cora/document/feed/RSSReader.java:69-81 (cora package, used by peer protocol source/net/yacy/peers/Protocol.java:456)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: opensearchdescriptionReader and RSSReader are not document parsers in TextParser's registry and only read 'trusted' federation/peer metadata, and RSSReader already installs an empty-InputSource EntityResolver (source/net/yacy/cora/document/feed/RSSReader.java:88-95), so a solver can argue they are out of the 'Parsers' scope or already protected.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: XML/XHTML/SVG documents carrying a public DOCTYPE declaration must still parse and index; the project's own test parses XHTML with a DOCTYPE through GenericXMLParser and expects 3 anchors. A blanket disallow-doctype-decl (as the published fix uses) applied to GenericXMLParser/ooxml would break this; the published fix itself makes DOCTYPE-bearing SVGs fail in svgParser.

O6_input_shapes: XML with any DOCTYPE (rejected via disallow-doctype-decl, fix.diff:28)
external parameter entity / external DTD subset (fix.diff:30)
input given as InputStream, as a path/URI string, and as an HTTP-fetched stream (source/net/yacy/document/parser/xml/opensearchdescriptionReader.java:131,141,153,170)

O7_producer.where: Parser instances are produced by per-class static getParser() helpers (e.g. source/net/yacy/document/parser/odtParser.java:99-110); no shared factory/config loader exists, and the handler passed to SAXParser.parse(..., DefaultHandler) becomes the effective EntityResolver (source/net/yacy/cora/document/feed/RSSReader.java:89-96)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a handler-level resolveEntity in one shared handler while a second handler used by the same parser lacks it (already the real situation in ooxmlParser)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the project already defends via handler resolveEntity overrides (source/net/yacy/document/parser/xml/OOXMLSpreeadsheetHandler.java:155-158) added per-handler, so a maintainer adding a new handler forgets it

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a resolver set on getXMLReader() that is silently replaced by the DefaultHandler passed to parse()
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the copied IBM tip comment shows the maintainer believed this pattern works; it is a mechanism (how-type) flaw, not a missing call

O10_build.project_tests: JUnit tests exist for test/java/net/yacy/document/parser/GenericXMLParserTest.java and test/java/net/yacy/document/parser/ooxmlParserTest.java; none for svgParser, mmParser, odtParser, opensearchdescriptionReader, RSSReader at the pinned commit; the fix adds no tests

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add disallow-doctype-decl to every SAXParserFactory found by grep, which breaks DOCTYPE-bearing XHTML in GenericXMLParser, and skip RSSReader because it 'already has a resolver' and the DOM DocumentBuilderFactory sites because they are not SAX.

out_of_scope_notes: The published fix replaces a ThreadLocal<SAXParser> with one static SAXParser shared across crawler threads (fix.diff:24-40); SAXParser is not thread-safe, a likely concurrency regression.
